# get_ton_wallet_ownership_proof_challenge()

**Qualified name:** `pyrogram.Client.get_ton_wallet_ownership_proof_challenge`

## Signature

```python
async def get_ton_wallet_ownership_proof_challenge() -> 'types.TonWalletOwnershipProofChallenge': ...
```

## Documentation

Get a challenge which can be used to prove the ownership of a TON wallet.

Sign it with the private key of the wallet and pass the result as a
[`TonWalletOwnershipProof`](../../types/wallet/TonWalletOwnershipProof.md) to the methods which require a proof.

**Available to:** User accounts.

### Returns

[`TonWalletOwnershipProofChallenge`](../../types/wallet/TonWalletOwnershipProofChallenge.md): On success, the challenge is returned.

### Example

```python
challenge = await app.get_ton_wallet_ownership_proof_challenge()
print(challenge.payload, challenge.domain)
```
